data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Public visibility and downloadability do not establish redistribution rights.

collection_context.session_checked_at_note: Initial navigation followed the 22:01:34 UTC clock check. Anonymous public access was confirmed by the sign-in button and absence of a login overlay before the card sample; the recorded confirmation timestamp uses the fresh card sample time.
collection_context.login_reason: Public discovery and detail metadata were accessible without authentication, so no sign-in was necessary or attempted.
collection_context.completion_note: Requested metadata, detail inspection, and cover acquisition completed. The game runtime warning is recorded but gameplay was outside collection scope.

scope.sampling_rule: First 10 game-card containers in this section's rendered DOM order; non-game creation promotion omitted. Nested action nodes are not counted as additional games.
scope.section_definition_raw: 过去 24 小时内玩家数量增幅最大
scope.position_semantics: DOM order among game cards in the actual section; no explicit numbered platform rank.

source_extensions.detail_selection_rule: First five unique games in Trending-then-Popular order; five total across the file. All five also occur in Popular. Independent detail_observations are stored once.

limitations: Bounded, non-random sample of rendered game-card DOM order, not an official numeric ranking or a platform-wide popularity census.
Anonymous public access with a visible sign-in button and no sign-in overlay. This differs from older authenticated-session and login-required samples.
Trending definition concerns player growth over 24 hours, but no growth value was supplied. Displayed plays and likes are not that growth measure.
Popular selected tab was 最热门游戏, verified aria-selected=true and its panel aria-hidden=false. Card order was not strictly descending by displayed plays.
The two sections were read independently from their own card elements. Repeated games remain separate observations, and their counts must not be added across sections.
Images had lazy-loading DOM state at the card observation. Actual bytes were subsequently downloaded from the exact observed image src and independently decoded.
Five detail pages showed a browser-component error for running games while public metadata remained visible. No gameplay input, voting, follow, sharing, or login action was performed.
No private areas, account identity, credentials, history, or content hidden behind a login/consent mask was collected. No earlier metric values, descriptions, or cover bytes were reused.
